constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates a text that has chosen nothing: it takes its size, weight and colour from whatever subtree it is put in, and the framework's own where nothing says otherwise (16 px, regular, the theme's on_surface).

methods.name: size
methods.doc: Sets the font size, in pixels.

methods.name: color
methods.doc: Sets the text color (otherwise the theme's).

methods.name: align
methods.doc: Where the lines sit inside the box the text was given.

methods.name: max_lines
methods.doc: At most max_lines lines; what is past them is dropped, and Text::overflow decides how the last one ends.

methods.name: heading
methods.doc: Wraps at the width the parent offers.

methods.name: wrap
methods.doc: Wraps the text at the width it is given: soft_wrap(true).

methods.name: no_wrap
methods.doc: Keeps the text on one line, explicit newlines aside.

methods.name: italic
methods.doc: Switches to italic.

methods.name: underline
methods.doc: Underlines the text.

methods.name: strikethrough
methods.doc: Strikes the text through.

methods.name: selectable
methods.doc: Makes this text selectable: a press, a drag, a double click or a long press selects words in it, and Ctrl+C, or the bar that opens over the selection, copies them.

constructors.name: row
constructors.doc: A container laying its children out horizontally.

constructors.name: column
constructors.doc: A container laying its children out vertically.

methods.name: child
methods.doc: Adds a child.

methods.name: gap
methods.doc: Spacing between children, in logical pixels.

methods.name: padding
methods.doc: Uniform padding, in logical pixels.

methods.name: width
methods.doc: Sets the width, in logical pixels.

methods.name: height
methods.doc: Sets the height, in logical pixels.

methods.name: flex
methods.doc: The flex grow factor along the parent's main axis.

methods.name: justify
methods.doc: How the children are distributed along the main axis.

methods.name: align
methods.doc: How the children are aligned on the cross axis.

methods.name: wrap
methods.doc: Turns wrapping on: children that overflow the main axis move to a new line, a responsive reflow.

methods.name: reverse
methods.doc: Lays the children out from the far end of the axis: a column from the bottom up, a row from the end of the line back.

methods.name: child
methods.doc: Adds a child.

methods.name: spacing
methods.doc: Space between adjacent children, in logical pixels.

methods.name: main_axis_alignment
methods.doc: How the children are distributed along the main axis.

methods.name: cross_axis_alignment
methods.doc: How the children are aligned across the main axis.

methods.name: shrink_wrap
methods.doc: Shrink-wraps the main axis: MainAxisSize::Min, named.

methods.name: child
methods.doc: Adds a child.

methods.name: spacing
methods.doc: Space between adjacent children, in logical pixels.

methods.name: main_axis_alignment
methods.doc: How the children are distributed along the main axis.

methods.name: cross_axis_alignment
methods.doc: How the children are aligned across the main axis.

methods.name: shrink_wrap
methods.doc: Shrink-wraps the main axis: MainAxisSize::Min, named.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates an empty container (automatic size, no decoration).

methods.name: child
methods.doc: Sets the container's child.

methods.name: width
methods.doc: Sets the width, in logical pixels.

methods.name: height
methods.doc: Sets the height, in logical pixels.

methods.name: max_width
methods.doc: At most width wide.

methods.name: min_height
methods.doc: At least height tall.

methods.name: max_height
methods.doc: At most height tall.

methods.name: padding
methods.doc: Uniform inner padding, in logical pixels.

methods.name: margin
methods.doc: A uniform outer margin: space reserved around the box, outside the decoration, it pushes the siblings away without growing the background or the border.

methods.name: radius
methods.doc: The rounded corner radii: uniform via f32 (.radius(10.0)) or per corner via BorderRadius (.radius(BorderRadius::top(12.0))).

methods.name: color
methods.doc: The background color at rest.

methods.name: border
methods.doc: The border: width (in px) and color, the same on all four sides.

methods.name: shadow
methods.doc: A drop shadow: the (dx, dy) offset, the blur radius and the color.

methods.name: opacity
methods.doc: Applies a group opacity [0,1] to the whole subtree, as one block: the rendering goes through a composited layer, so overlaps are not double-blended.

methods.name: rotated
methods.doc: Turned by radians when painted, about the transform_alignment.

methods.name: flex
methods.doc: Flex growth factor along the parent's main axis.

methods.name: on_click
methods.doc: The message emitted when the container is clicked.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Insets child by padding.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Centres child.

methods.name: width_factor
methods.doc: The box is factor times as wide as its child.

methods.name: height_factor
methods.doc: The box is factor times as tall as its child.

constructors.name: empty
constructors.doc: An empty box, Auto on both axes until a size is set.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: A box holding child, its size still to be chosen.

constructors.name: square
constructors.doc: A side×side box holding child.

constructors.name: expand
constructors.doc: A box that fills the space on offer, on both axes, and hands it to child.

methods.name: width
methods.doc: Sets the width, in logical pixels.

methods.name: height
methods.doc: Sets the height, in logical pixels.

methods.name: child
methods.doc: Sets the child, replacing any already there.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: A gap that takes the whole of what is left (a flex factor of 1).

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Wraps inner, which then takes all the spare room (a flex factor of 1).

methods.name: flex
methods.doc: The share of the spare room, when several children expand: two children at flex(2.0) and flex(1.0) split it two to one.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates an empty stack.

methods.name: layer
methods.doc: Adds a layer, on top of the previous ones.

methods.name: width
methods.doc: Sets the width, in logical pixels.

methods.name: height
methods.doc: Sets the height, in logical pixels.

methods.name: flex
methods.doc: Flex growth factor along the parent's main axis.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Wraps a layer, pinned nowhere yet (which on its own is the stack's alignment at the child's natural size.

methods.name: left
methods.doc: Distance from the stack's left edge) the left in either reading direction; see start for one that follows the script.

methods.name: top
methods.doc: Distance from the stack's top edge.

methods.name: right
methods.doc: Distance from the stack's right edge.

methods.name: bottom
methods.doc: Distance from the stack's bottom edge.

methods.name: width
methods.doc: An explicit width, used when only one horizontal edge is pinned.

methods.name: height
methods.doc: An explicit height, used when only one vertical edge is pinned.

methods.name: inset
methods.doc: Pins all four edges: the layer fills the stack inset by px on every side.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates a box at the given width / height ratio, clamped to > 0.

methods.name: child
methods.doc: Sets the child constrained to the ratio.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Wraps child in a group opacity of opacity.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Clips the child to a rounded rectangle of radius logical pixels, uniform across all four corners.

methods.name: child
methods.doc: Sets the clipped child.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Shows child.

methods.name: visible
methods.doc: Whether the child is shown.

methods.name: maintain_size
methods.doc: Keeps the child's box while hidden: it is laid out and measured as usual, but not drawn, not clickable and not read out.

methods.name: replacement
methods.doc: What to show in the child's place when it is hidden and its box is not maintained.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates a scrollable area.

methods.name: child
methods.doc: Sets the scrollable content.

methods.name: reverse
methods.doc: Scrolls from the far end: the content is anchored to the bottom of a vertical viewport (the right of a horizontal one) and the area starts there.

methods.name: width
methods.doc: Sets the viewport width, in logical pixels.

methods.name: height
methods.doc: Sets the viewport height, in logical pixels.

methods.name: flex
methods.doc: Flex growth factor along the parent's main axis.

methods.name: padding
methods.doc: Insets the content, inside the viewport: the padding scrolls with what it surrounds rather than shrinking the window onto it.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates a list of count items of extent item_extent, each item being built on demand by build(index).

constructors.name: builder
constructors.doc: A virtualised list of count items of any extent, built on demand by build(index) (a feed of posts of different lengths, a chat, search results with and without a picture.

methods.name: estimated_extent
methods.doc: The extent to count an item at before any has been measured, for a list made by ListView::builder.

methods.name: reverse
methods.doc: Builds from the far end: item 0 sits at the end the axis finishes at) the bottom of a vertical list, the trailing edge of a horizontal one, item 1 before it, and the list starts resting there.

methods.name: padding
methods.doc: Insets the content, inside the viewport: the padding scrolls with what it surrounds rather than shrinking the window onto it.

methods.name: width
methods.doc: Sets the viewport width, in logical pixels.

methods.name: height
methods.doc: Sets the viewport height, in logical pixels.

methods.name: flex
methods.doc: Flex growth factor along the parent's main axis.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates a grid of columns columns, at least one.

constructors.name: builder
constructors.doc: A grid of count tiles in columns columns, of which only the visible rows are built, laid out and painted.

methods.name: cell
methods.doc: Adds a cell, placed automatically in the grid.

methods.name: gap
methods.doc: Spacing between cells (rows and columns), in logical pixels.

methods.name: row_gap
methods.doc: Spacing between rows only, in logical pixels.

methods.name: column_gap
methods.doc: Spacing between columns only, in logical pixels.

methods.name: aspect
methods.doc: Gives every cell the same shape: a width / height ratio, so 1.0 is a square tile, 1.5 a landscape one and 0.75 a portrait one.

methods.name: width
methods.doc: Sets the width, in logical pixels.

methods.name: height
methods.doc: Sets the height, in logical pixels.

methods.name: flex
methods.doc: Flex growth factor along the parent's main axis.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates an elevated card, with a default padding of 16.

methods.name: child
methods.doc: Sets the card's content.

methods.name: filled
methods.doc: A flat tonal card: no shadow, no outline.

methods.name: outlined
methods.doc: An outlined card: a hairline, no shadow.

methods.name: padding
methods.doc: Uniform padding inside the card.

methods.name: margin
methods.doc: Uniform room outside the card.

methods.name: elevation
methods.doc: How far off the surface the card sits.

methods.name: color
methods.doc: Overrides the background colour.

methods.name: radius
methods.doc: Rounds the card's corners with radius.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates a separator with the theme's colour and the default spacing.

methods.name: height
methods.doc: The room the separator takes in the layout, line and air together.

methods.name: thickness
methods.doc: The thickness of the line itself.

methods.name: indent
methods.doc: Insets the line from the leading edge, leaving the box where it is, how a list separates rows without cutting through their leading icons.

methods.name: end_indent
methods.doc: Insets the line from the trailing edge.

methods.name: color
methods.doc: Overrides the line's colour.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: A button reading label.

methods.name: on_press
methods.doc: Message emitted on a press.

methods.name: on_long_press
methods.doc: Message emitted on a long press, which takes the place of the press.

methods.name: enabled
methods.doc: Enables or disables the button.

methods.name: color
methods.doc: The surface while enabled.

methods.name: label_color
methods.doc: The label's colour while enabled.

methods.name: radius
methods.doc: The corner radii (uniform via f32, per corner via BorderRadius).

methods.name: padding
methods.doc: The room either side of the content.

methods.name: min_width
methods.doc: The narrowest it will be, before the visual density.

methods.name: elevation
methods.doc: How far it sits off the surface in every state while enabled.

methods.name: size
methods.doc: Font size, sugar for Button::label_style with the label step resized.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: A button showing one of the bundled icons.

methods.name: on_press
methods.doc: The message emitted on click.

methods.name: label
methods.doc: What a screen reader announces.

methods.name: selected
methods.doc: Makes it a toggle, on or off; on, the glyph takes the accent.

methods.name: enabled
methods.doc: Enables or disables it.

methods.name: size
methods.doc: The box's side.

methods.name: icon_size
methods.doc: The glyph's size inside it.

methods.name: color
methods.doc: The surface under the glyph.

methods.name: icon_color
methods.doc: The glyph's colour.

methods.name: radius
methods.doc: The corner radii.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: A button carrying a glyph.

constructors.name: extended
constructors.doc: An extended button: words, and optionally a glyph before them through icon.

methods.name: icon
methods.doc: The glyph, over whatever was there.

methods.name: small
methods.doc: The smaller box: 40 across, cornered at 12, with the same glyph.

methods.name: large
methods.doc: The larger box: 96 across, cornered at 28, with a 36 glyph.

methods.name: on_press
methods.doc: What it does.

methods.name: enabled
methods.doc: Whether it can be pressed.

methods.name: background
methods.doc: The surface, over the theme's and primary_container.

methods.name: foreground
methods.doc: What is drawn on it, over the theme's and on_primary_container.

methods.name: elevation
methods.doc: How far off the page it sits at rest, in pixels.

methods.name: radius
methods.doc: The shorthand for a rounded rectangle.

methods.name: icon_size
methods.doc: How big the glyph is, over the theme's and the size's own.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates a control: selected is the active index, on_select(i) fires on click.

methods.name: segment
methods.doc: Adds a segment.

methods.name: radius
methods.doc: The radius of the group's outer corners.

methods.name: selected_color
methods.doc: The fill under the chosen segment.

methods.name: label_color
methods.doc: The labels' colour.

methods.name: selected_label_color
methods.doc: The chosen segment's label colour, and its checkmark's.

methods.name: border_color
methods.doc: The outline's colour, which is also the hairlines' between segments.

methods.name: height
methods.doc: The control's height.

methods.name: padding
methods.doc: The room either side of a label.

methods.name: enabled
methods.doc: Greys the whole control out and makes it inert: no press, no ink, out of the tab order, and announced as disabled.

methods.name: show_selected_icon
methods.doc: Whether the chosen segment carries a checkmark.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: An icon in the theme's colour and at the theme's size, 24 px unless a theme says otherwise.

methods.name: size
methods.doc: Sets the size, that is, the square's side, in logical pixels.

methods.name: color
methods.doc: Forces the colour; the theme's otherwise, and on_surface if it says nothing.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates a checkbox whose checked state is supplied.

constructors.name: maybe
constructors.doc: A checkbox with three answers: on, off, and partly on.

methods.name: label
methods.doc: Adds a label after it.

methods.name: enabled
methods.doc: Whether the box can be ticked.

methods.name: on_toggle
methods.doc: A closure producing a message from the new state, checked or not.

methods.name: fill_color
methods.doc: The box's fill when it is ticked; the theme's, then primary.

methods.name: check_color
methods.doc: The tick drawn on that fill; the theme's, then on_primary.

methods.name: radius
methods.doc: The box's corner radius.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: A radio, chosen or not.

methods.name: label
methods.doc: The words beside it.

methods.name: label_size
methods.doc: The label's size, in pixels.

methods.name: on_select
methods.doc: What to say when it is pressed.

methods.name: enabled
methods.doc: Whether it can be pressed.

methods.name: selected_color
methods.doc: The ring and the dot while it is the chosen one, over the theme's and primary.

methods.name: border_color
methods.doc: The ring while it is not, at rest.

methods.name: label_color
methods.doc: The label's colour.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates a switch whose state is supplied.

methods.name: on_toggle
methods.doc: A closure producing a message from the new state.

methods.name: enabled
methods.doc: Whether the switch can be flipped.

methods.name: track_color
methods.doc: The track's colour when the switch is on, in every state; the theme's primary otherwise.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates a slider at the given value, over 0.0..=1.0 until range says otherwise.

methods.name: on_change
methods.doc: A closure producing a message from the new value, in the slider's units.

methods.name: range
methods.doc: The travel this slider covers; 0.0..=1.0 by default.

methods.name: divisions
methods.doc: Splits the travel into n steps: the value snaps to min + k·(max−min)/n, a tick marks each, and an arrow key moves by one of them.

methods.name: width
methods.doc: The width, in logical pixels.

methods.name: enabled
methods.doc: Whether the slider can be moved.

methods.name: active_color
methods.doc: The travelled part of the track, and the thumb unless thumb_color names it; the scheme's primary otherwise.

methods.name: inactive_color
methods.doc: The part of the track still to travel; the scheme's surface_container_highest otherwise.

methods.name: thumb_color
methods.doc: The thumb's fill; the active colour otherwise.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates a rating: value filled stars out of max.

methods.name: enabled
methods.doc: Whether the rating can be changed.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates a picker: the current value plus a message for each new value.

methods.name: range
methods.doc: Clamps the value to [min, max].

methods.name: enabled
methods.doc: Whether the value can be changed.

methods.name: step
methods.doc: Sets the increment step, at least 1.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates a field displaying value.

methods.name: on_input
methods.doc: Closure producing a message from the field's new value.

methods.name: label
methods.doc: Label displayed above the field.

methods.name: placeholder
methods.doc: Hint displayed inside the field while it is empty (and, for a field with no label, the name a screen reader gives it.

methods.name: helper
methods.doc: Helper text below the field (replaced by the error, if present).

methods.name: error
methods.doc: Marks the field in error: red border and label, message displayed below the field.

methods.name: width
methods.doc: Sets the width, in logical pixels.

methods.name: outlined
methods.doc: Outlined: a box the caller can see all the way round, the floating label notching its top border.

methods.name: filled
methods.doc: The filled variant: a tinted container with a single line under it, the label floating inside.

methods.name: borderless
methods.doc: Filled: a tinted container with a single line under it, the label floating inside the box rather than on its edge.

methods.name: multiline
methods.doc: Switches the field to multi-line: Enter inserts a line break (instead of submitting), and the box shows rows lines (see rows).

methods.name: obscure
methods.doc: Masks the value (a password field): every character becomes a dot.

methods.name: enabled
methods.doc: Greys the field out and makes it inert.

methods.name: prefix_icon
methods.doc: Decorative icon on the left inside the field.

methods.name: suffix_icon
methods.doc: Decorative icon on the right inside the field.

methods.name: read_only
methods.doc: A field whose value can be read, selected and copied) but not changed.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates a chip with the given label.

methods.name: selected
methods.doc: Marks the chip selected: it fills, its label takes the colour that goes with the fill, and a checkmark appears in the leading slot unless there is an icon there already (or Chip::show_checkmark says otherwise).

methods.name: leading
methods.doc: A leading icon, the avatar or glyph an entry chip carries.

methods.name: enabled
methods.doc: Greys the chip out and makes it inert: no press, no ink, out of the tab order, and announced to a reader as disabled rather than simply going quiet.

methods.name: on_press
methods.doc: The message the chip emits when pressed.

methods.name: on_remove
methods.doc: Adds a delete cross that emits message.

methods.name: color
methods.doc: The surface under an unselected chip.

methods.name: selected_color
methods.doc: The surface under a selected one.

methods.name: label_color
methods.doc: The label's colour when unselected.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: An empty avatar: the colour alone, at the default radius.

constructors.name: initials
constructors.doc: An avatar showing the initials of name: the first letters of its first two words, upper-cased, or its first two letters when it is one word.

methods.name: child
methods.doc: What is shown in the circle, centred: usually a text, or an icon.

methods.name: background_color
methods.doc: The colour the circle is filled with; the scheme's primary_container otherwise.

methods.name: foreground_color
methods.doc: The colour of the child's text and icons; the scheme's on_primary_container otherwise.

methods.name: radius
methods.doc: The radius, in logical pixels: the avatar is this big, whatever it holds.

methods.name: size
methods.doc: The size as a diameter: Self::radius of half of it.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: A badge carrying text.

constructors.name: count
constructors.doc: A badge carrying a count: the number, or 999+ past max_count.

constructors.name: dot
constructors.doc: A badge with no label: a small dot.

methods.name: max_count
methods.doc: The largest count written out; past it the badge reads max+.

methods.name: label_visible
methods.doc: Whether the badge is shown.

methods.name: text_color
methods.doc: The label's colour on that fill; the theme's on_error otherwise.

methods.name: padding
methods.doc: The label's room either side.

methods.name: on
methods.doc: Pins this badge to child: drawn over it, at its top-end corner unless alignment says otherwise.

constructors.name: new

methods.name: child
methods.doc: The widget the tooltip describes.

methods.name: radius

constructors.doc: Creates an informational box.

methods.name: title
methods.doc: Adds a title.

methods.name: success
methods.doc: The success variant.

methods.name: warning
methods.doc: Variante avertissement.

methods.name: error
methods.doc: Variante erreur.

methods.name: width
methods.doc: Sets the width, in logical pixels.

methods.name: height
methods.doc: Sets the height, in logical pixels.

methods.name: radius
methods.doc: Sets the corner radius.

constructors.name: network
constructors.doc: An image fetched over the network, decoded and shown when it arrives.

methods.name: width
methods.doc: Sets the width, in logical pixels.

methods.name: height
methods.doc: Sets the height, in logical pixels.

methods.name: size

methods.name: tint
methods.doc: A multiplied tint, white leaving it unchanged, for bitmap icons, say.

methods.name: semantic_label
methods.doc: What a screen reader says instead of the picture.

methods.doc: Flex growth factor along the parent's main axis.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: A determinate bar, filled to value, clamped to 0.0..=1.0.

constructors.name: indeterminate
constructors.doc: An indeterminate bar: the work is under way and how long it will take is not known, so two lines run along the track for as long as it is shown.

methods.name: width
methods.doc: Sets the width, in logical pixels.

methods.name: color
methods.doc: The colour of the fill, over the theme's and primary.

methods.name: radius
methods.doc: The corners of the fill, the lines and the track. Unset, square in the 2023 look and 2 px in the newer one.

constructors.name: determinate
constructors.doc: A determinate indicator, its arc swept to value, clamped to 0.0..=1.0.

methods.name: color
methods.doc: The colour of the arc, over the theme's and primary.

methods.name: stroke_width
methods.doc: How thick the arc is. Unset, the theme's, then four.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates tabs: selected is the active index, on_select(i) the message on click.

methods.name: tab
methods.doc: Adds a tab, a label plus content.

methods.name: icon_tab
methods.doc: Adds a tab with an icon over its label.

methods.name: icon_only_tab
methods.doc: Adds a tab showing only an icon, in a row of the ordinary height.

methods.name: swipeable
methods.doc: Whether a drag across the panel changes tab.

methods.name: scrollable
methods.doc: Lets the bar scroll rather than sharing its width between the tabs.

methods.name: enabled
methods.doc: Whether the bar can be switched.

methods.name: indicator_color
methods.doc: The indicator's colour.

methods.name: label_color
methods.doc: The selected label's colour.

methods.name: unselected_label_color
methods.doc: The colour of every label but the selected one.

methods.name: divider_color
methods.doc: The hairline's colour.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: A bar whose item current_index is selected, calling on_tap with the index of an item tapped.

methods.name: item
methods.doc: Adds a destination.

methods.name: elevation
methods.doc: How far the bar sits off the page.

methods.name: background_color
methods.doc: The bar's colour, for a fixed bar.

methods.name: icon_size
methods.doc: The icons' size.

methods.name: selected_item_color
methods.doc: The selected item's colour, icon and label.

methods.name: unselected_item_color
methods.doc: The other items' colour.

methods.name: show_selected_labels
methods.doc: Whether the selected item's label shows.

methods.name: show_unselected_labels
methods.doc: Whether the other items' labels show.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates a shell for the surface it is being built for.

methods.name: app_bar
methods.doc: The application bar, pinned at the top.

methods.name: fab
methods.doc: A floating action button, anchored bottom-right, above the bottom bar.

methods.name: background
methods.doc: Background color, spread edge to edge, including under the system bars.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: Creates a bar with no title, as wide as the surface it is being built for (which is what decides how many actions fit on the line and how many fold into the overflow menu.

methods.name: title
methods.doc: The title, as any widget) a text, a logo, a composed row.

methods.name: leading
methods.doc: The leading element (a menu or back button…), optional.

methods.name: action
methods.doc: Adds an action: any widget, at the bar's trailing end, after those already added.

methods.name: center_title
methods.doc: Centres the title in the space left between the leading and the actions, rather than starting it flush after the leading.

methods.name: background
methods.doc: The bar's background color (transparent by default: the parent decides).

methods.name: foreground
methods.doc: The colour of the bar's own text (the title, and the labelled actions.

methods.name: elevation
methods.doc: How far off the page the bar sits.

methods.name: height
methods.doc: An imposed bar height (by default, the content's natural height).

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: A row with wrapping turned on.

constructors.name: of
constructors.doc: The description currently in force, or UNSET outside any scope.

constructors.name: hex
constructors.doc: Builds a colour from a CSS hex code (see Color::try_hex).

constructors.name: uniform
constructors.doc: The same inset on all four sides.

constructors.name: symmetric
constructors.doc: horizontal on the left and the right, vertical on the top and the bottom.

constructors.name: new
constructors.doc: An item with icon) one of the bundled icons, or a glyph, and label.
